trigger.description: The bounded stdin supplied to `ee mesh grant` is malformed, tampered, signed by a non-current key, or authenticated for a different store, workspace, or command surface. All unauthenticated causes collapse to one high-severity error so the response cannot become a target, key, MAC, or snapshot authentication oracle. No lane state or audit row is written.
trigger.invocation: printf '%s\n' 'eeap1_invalid-bearer' | ee mesh grant peer_example123 --lane body --preview-token-stdin --workspace . --json

message_contains: invalid for this store, workspace, and command
expected_emission.repair_string: Run the read-only lane preview again and submit its new approval token through bounded stdin.
